criteria.name: Hierarchy, grouping and primary actions
criteria.note: Clear app header, navigation rail, outline, cell cards and primary Run all action.

criteria.name: Typography, spacing and alignment
criteria.note: Readable code and comfortable card spacing; secondary labels are small.

criteria.name: Theme and component consistency
criteria.note: Light and dark themes share a coherent component vocabulary.

criteria.name: Information density and restraint
criteria.note: Notebook is balanced; repeated operation records and JSON clutter supporting screens.

criteria.name: Primary destinations and current location
criteria.note: Six clearly labeled destinations and visible active selection.

criteria.name: Cell outline, selection and filtering
criteria.note: Filtering and no-match feedback work; filtering affects only the outline and selection can remain offscreen.

criteria.name: History drill-down and return path
criteria.note: Sessions to executions to detail works, but no visible breadcrumb or dedicated back action.

criteria.name: Context isolation across screens
criteria.note: Settings retains doctor JSON and a prior panel's scroll position; source confirms one shared inspection value.

criteria.name: Initial value proposition and first action
criteria.note: Clear welcome text, Open notebook CTA and statement that opening starts no worker.

criteria.name: Create-notebook journey
criteria.note: Startup only offers opening a directory; creating a notebook requires CLI knowledge.

criteria.name: Recent work and example discoverability
criteria.note: No visible recent notebook list, guided example or sample notebook action.

criteria.name: Shortcut introduction and mental model
criteria.note: Shortcut list is helpful, but run shortcut behavior depends on focus in ways the list does not explain.

criteria.name: Code readability and editing affordances
criteria.note: Python syntax highlighting, line numbers and labeled cell editors are present.

criteria.name: Persistence and stale-source awareness
criteria.note: An edit was saved to cells/sales.py; stale output badge and outline marker appeared.

criteria.name: Add-cell focus and placement
criteria.note: Adding succeeds but keeps the old viewport and selection rather than placing the new editor in view.

criteria.name: Structural editing and undo
criteria.note: Add/delete work; delete is immediate and Ctrl+Z did not restore the cell. Structural undo is documented as unfinished.

criteria.name: Single-cell and batch execution
criteria.note: Mouse run and Run all executed code and retained output; batch error was visible.

criteria.name: Running state and interruption
criteria.note: A 30-second sleep showed Running, then Interrupted and Idle after Interrupt.

criteria.name: Runtime lifecycle and offline inspection
criteria.note: Open was offline and first execution started a worker. Final Stop shut down the runtime but left a Disconnected chip and OS error 10053; reopening is needed for a clean offline state.

criteria.name: Capability gating and action scope
criteria.note: Global execution controls remain on inspection/settings screens; idle interrupt and destructive controls have little state-specific guidance.

criteria.name: Execution result and global status
criteria.note: Runtime chip, cell status and execution ordinal make completion and running state visible.

criteria.name: Save, stale and empty-result feedback
criteria.note: Stale output, outline markers and No cells match provide useful feedback.

criteria.name: Operation identity and progress meaning
criteria.note: Operations show UUID/state without task names or timestamps; after Stop, a running operation label remained despite runtime shutdown.

criteria.name: Session versus worker state terminology
criteria.note: History session says running while the worker chip says Idle; this distinction is not explained.

criteria.name: Text, expressions and Python errors
criteria.note: Text/result separation and a prominent traceback preserve useful detail.

criteria.name: Tables and image rendering
criteria.note: A four-row pandas table and matplotlib PNG rendered correctly in the native UI.

criteria.name: Markdown and source/output relationship
criteria.note: Markdown renders with emphasis and headings, but source and preview occupy space simultaneously.

criteria.name: Output tooling and rich-content coverage
criteria.note: MIME chooser/export, output search, full attachment preview and bounded large-output paging remain unfinished; not all MIME types were exercised.

criteria.name: Human-readable record summaries
criteria.note: Execution rows primarily contain UUIDs; cell names, time and duration are missing from the list.

criteria.name: Detail presentation and source comparison
criteria.note: Data is available as raw JSON; source comparison and a formatted execution detail view are missing.

criteria.name: Find, filter and sort recorded work
criteria.note: No visible history search or time/status filtering; the left search is cell filtering.

criteria.name: Runtime identity and actionable discovery
criteria.note: Runtime rows show IDs and verified badges rather than useful path/interpreter/activity summaries.

criteria.name: Checkpoint creation and restoration
criteria.note: A complete checkpoint was created and restored; ledger records a new session linked to it.

criteria.name: Diagnostics and reconnect tools
criteria.note: Doctor/reconnect tools exist but use raw JSON. Reconnect/reload was clicked after Stop; the Disconnected chip and error remained in the follow-up capture, although later history inspection worked.

criteria.name: Recovery guidance and preflight clarity
criteria.note: Trust/mismatch options and warning exist; no concise summary of restored bindings or typed recovery guidance.

criteria.name: Crash, conflict and draft recovery
criteria.note: Draft/conflict/recovery features are documented but crashes, simultaneous edits and draft replay were not induced. Stop-related disconnect behavior is rated in the lifecycle/diagnostics criteria.

criteria.name: Deletion protection and recovery
criteria.note: One click removes the source cell from the notebook immediately; no confirmation, Undo action or working structural Ctrl+Z observed. This does not claim execution history or all possible CLI recovery paths are erased.

criteria.name: Namespace-changing action confirmation
criteria.note: Restore and Stop ask for confirmation; Escape dismisses and trust/mismatch are explicit.

criteria.name: Action-specific warning and button copy
criteria.note: Stop reuses a warning about executing saved code, target is {}, and the action label is generic Proceed.

criteria.name: Trust, attachment and close semantics
criteria.note: Trust options and closing-detaches message are visible. This is a UX assessment, not a security audit.

criteria.name: Run shortcuts from editor focus
criteria.note: Shift+Enter and Ctrl+Enter inserted newlines in editor focus; Escape followed by Shift+Enter executed the selected cell.

criteria.name: Command-palette keyboard activation
criteria.note: Filtering checkpoint worked, but Arrow Down + Enter did not select or execute it; implementation has click handlers only.

criteria.name: Escape and mode visibility
criteria.note: Escape dismisses confirmations and returns to command mode; status bar distinguishes edit/command mode.

criteria.name: Complete tab journey and modal focus containment
criteria.note: Focusable controls exist, but a full Tab/Shift+Tab journey, focus restoration and modal trap were not tested.

criteria.name: Native semantics and accessible labels
criteria.note: UI Automation exposes 29 descendants including named buttons/inputs/editors. Navigation destinations and rendered outputs were absent from this snapshot.

criteria.name: Window and contextual accessible identity
criteria.note: Native window has an empty title/name and repeated Run/Delete labels lack a cell name in the exposed tree.

criteria.name: Measured text, nontext and focus contrast
criteria.note: Visual inspection alone cannot certify contrast. No pixel/token contrast calculation was performed.

criteria.name: Screen reader, high contrast, IME and text scaling
criteria.note: NVDA, system high contrast, IME, mixed DPI and enlarged text remain qualification work; no conformance claim.

criteria.name: Standard-width containment
criteria.note: Notebook is usable at about 1280 logical pixels, but checkpoint row actions already clip on the right.

criteria.name: Compact-window controls
criteria.note: At 800 logical pixels, runtime state and cell-add actions are clipped; no adaptive toolbar overflow was visible.

criteria.name: Dialog wrapping and inspection reflow
criteria.note: Confirmation description paints past the right edge; checkpoint actions clip at 1024 and 800.

criteria.name: Mixed DPI, secondary monitor and extreme sizing
criteria.note: Observed on one Windows display at 200% scaling; other DPI configurations and monitors were not tested.

criteria.name: Small-notebook responsiveness
criteria.note: Observed interactions completed and app stayed responsive while code ran; no app crash during completed workflows.

criteria.name: Measured startup and interaction latency
criteria.note: No repeatable timing harness was run. Screenshot-tool time is not an application latency measurement.

criteria.name: Large notebooks, history and output
criteria.note: Six-cell fixture only; no large history, 100 MiB output, image-cache or long-session stress test.

criteria.name: Resource use and rendering stability
criteria.note: Memory, frame times, GPU fallback and long-running resource behavior were not measured.

criteria.name: Theme discoverability and operation
criteria.note: Header and Settings theme switches work.

criteria.name: Interpreter clarity
criteria.note: Choose project interpreter exists, but current selected path/version is not summarized in Settings; picker was not exercised.

criteria.name: Preference persistence and system integration
criteria.note: Dark theme returned to light on relaunch; source initializes apply_theme(false) and dark:false.

criteria.name: Customization depth
criteria.note: System/high-contrast preference, key rebinding and full config fields remain unfinished.

criteria.name: Contextual help and documentation access
criteria.note: Startup shortcuts and tooltips help, but no visible in-app help, glossary or documentation entry point.

criteria.name: Language and domain concepts
criteria.note: Ordinary notebook labels are clear; namespace, runtime, interpreter and Continue/Restore need explanation.

criteria.name: Native shell identity and release information
criteria.note: Window title is empty and version/About is not visible. Installer, signing and update UX were not tested.

criteria.name: Discovery of incomplete workflows
criteria.note: Coverage is honestly documented in the repo, but UI offers little guidance about unimplemented exchange/publish workflows.

findings.title: Run shortcuts are swallowed by the editor
findings.reproduction: Focus code editor; press Shift+Enter or Ctrl+Enter. A newline is inserted. Escape, then Shift+Enter runs.
findings.recommendation: Route notebook run bindings before editor newline handlers; keep focus behavior explicit and consistent.
findings.acceptance: Both shortcuts execute once from editor and command mode without changing source; define Shift+Enter run-next behavior.

findings.title: Command palette cannot activate results with keys
findings.reproduction: Open palette, type checkpoint, press Arrow Down and Enter. The palette remains and no operation starts.
findings.recommendation: Maintain active result index, support arrows/Enter, visible selection and focus restoration.
findings.acceptance: Open, filter, select and execute each command entirely by keyboard; Escape dismisses.

findings.title: Cell deletion has no immediate recovery
findings.reproduction: Delete a saved cell. It disappears immediately. Ctrl+Z does not bring it back.
findings.recommendation: Add structural undo and an Undo notification; use a clear confirmation until reliable undo exists.
findings.acceptance: Undo restores the exact cell source, kind, position and identity; failed delete preserves source.

findings.title: Important controls clip in normal and compact windows
findings.reproduction: Open Checkpoints at 1280, 1024 and 800 logical pixels. Restore/status rows clip; small notebook windows clip add-cell/runtime controls.
findings.recommendation: Make inspection rows shrink/wrap; add toolbar overflow and a collapsible outline; set and communicate minimum supported dimensions.
findings.acceptance: All primary actions and status are reachable at documented minimum size in both themes.

findings.title: Critical dialog text overflows and uses generic wording
findings.reproduction: Open Restore or Stop confirmation; description extends outside the dialog. Stop warns about running saved code and shows {}.
findings.recommendation: Wrap description; use action-specific consequences and button names; show a useful target summary.
findings.acceptance: Every confirmation stays contained at minimum size; Stop says Stop runtime and Restore identifies its checkpoint.

findings.title: Native accessibility identity is incomplete
findings.reproduction: UI Automation shows an unnamed app window and named controls, but no six navigation destinations or output semantics in the captured tree.
findings.recommendation: Expose native navigation roles/names/current state, contextual control names and accessible output content; set app/notebook window title.
findings.acceptance: NVDA can identify the window, navigate all destinations, read source/output/status and operate dialogs without a mouse.

findings.title: Normal runtime stop is displayed as a connection failure
findings.reproduction: After rich-output execution, Stop shut down the runtime, confirmed by CLI status, but UI showed Disconnected and raw OS error 10053. Reconnect/reload did not clear that state in the follow-up capture; a running operation label remained.
findings.recommendation: Handle intentional shutdown as an expected lifecycle event; reconcile operation completion and refresh connection state; distinguish runtime stopped from transport failure.
findings.acceptance: Repeated Stop from idle/busy states gives a stopped/offline state without an OS error; history stays readable and no completed operation remains running.

findings.title: Recorded work is presented as identifiers and JSON
findings.reproduction: History and Runtimes list UUIDs; execution detail and doctor results are raw JSON.
findings.recommendation: Show cell name/source preview, local timestamp, duration, interpreter/path and status; place raw JSON in an optional details disclosure.
findings.acceptance: A user can locate a failed cell or current runtime without reading UUIDs/JSON.

findings.title: Settings inherits unrelated diagnostic state
findings.reproduction: Scroll Doctor results down, switch to Settings. Old scroll position and doctor JSON remain.
findings.recommendation: Scope inspection data and scroll position per destination; reset new-view scroll or restore only its own prior state.
findings.acceptance: Settings opens on preferences and does not display results from Doctor or another destination.

findings.title: Adding/selecting a cell does not reliably reveal its editor
findings.reproduction: Add code cell at bottom; existing selection and viewport remain. Select new outline entry; editor still requires extra scrolling.
findings.recommendation: Select, reveal and focus newly added cell after mutation acknowledgement; scroll using measured card bounds.
findings.acceptance: One add action yields a visible focused editor without extra navigation, including after large output.

findings.title: Theme preference resets on relaunch
findings.reproduction: Switch to dark, close and relaunch. Startup returns to light; source hardcodes initial light theme.
findings.recommendation: Persist appearance selection and offer Follow system with accessible high-contrast support.
findings.acceptance: Relaunch restores selection and system mode follows OS preference.

findings.title: First use assumes an initialized notebook directory
findings.reproduction: Launch without a path. Only Open notebook is offered.
findings.recommendation: Offer Create notebook, recent notebooks and a small sample; explain invalid/uninitialized directory recovery.
findings.acceptance: A new user can create, edit, run and save a first notebook through the UI.

findings.title: Session and worker states can look contradictory
findings.reproduction: History labels the open session running while runtime chip reads Idle.
findings.recommendation: Use Active session for session lifecycle and reserve Running for computation; add a short state explanation.
findings.acceptance: Idle worker plus active session has clearly distinct labels and contextual help.
